answer: An agent marketplace weights each agent’s vote by tokens locked in escrow, with no bonus for opening an account. Agents trading forecasts about knoll erosion, lotus growth, or tundra thaw follow the same rule. Splitting 100 tokens across 1,000 fake identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital for the escrow period.
